expected.name: rrn
expected.description: The report reference number as published where not empty, NULL where empty (126 rows). Unique where present.

expected.name: uprn_sepcr
expected.description: The register's own 10-digit number for the building, trimmed and as an integer. Not the Gazetteer UPRN. Present in every row.

expected.name: uprn_osg
expected.description: The One Scotland Gazetteer UPRN as an integer, NULL where the published cell is empty (35.4% of rows). The only column a UPRN join compares. A padded cohort UPRN matches once cast to bigint.

expected.name: pc_norm
expected.description: POSTCODE in upper case with every space and tab removed. NULL where nothing is left. Nothing repaired. The postcode join normalises the cohort postcode by the same rule.

expected.name: datazone_2001
expected.description: The 2001 data zone code when DATA_ZONE starts with S01 and six digits followed by a space or the end, otherwise NULL.

expected.name: datazone_2001_status
expected.description: code, empty, not_a_datazone (for 00QQMB and the like) or unknown_code (well formed, not in the pinned list. The build fails if any).

expected.name: datazone_2011
expected.description: The 2011 data zone code by the same rule, otherwise NULL.

expected.name: datazone_2011_status
expected.description: As datazone_2001_status, for the 2011 column.

expected.name: inspection_date_parsed
expected.description: INSPECTION_DATE (yyyy-mm-dd) as a date: the day the assessor saw the building. The dated joins choose the certificate by it. Outliers (2002 to 2108) are kept as published. A value that does not parse stops the build.

expected.name: lodgement_date_parsed
expected.description: LODGEMENT_DATE (yyyy-mm-dd) as a date. The administrative date of the certificate, a median of 8 days after the inspection. The ten-year validity runs from it.

expected.name: created_at_parsed
expected.description: CREATED_AT (dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm:ss) as a timestamp to the second: when the certificate was lodged on the register. Never later than the last day of the release quarter.

expected.name: historic_flag
expected.description: 1 where HISTORIC is True (the certificate has been superseded), 0 where False. Any other value stops the build.

expected.name: floor_area_int
expected.description: The conditioned floor area of the building in square metres as an integer, 4 to 138,037 in this release. Shared with dwellings in unit, not in what is measured.

expected.name: current_energy_performance_rating_int
expected.description: The current energy performance rating as an integer: calculated emissions in kg of CO2 per square metre per year, lower is better, negative allowed. Not the domestic rating, which scores energy cost and where higher is better.

expected.name: potential_energy_performance_rating_num
expected.description: The potential energy performance rating (kg of CO2 per square metre per year after the listed improvements) as decimal(19,4). NULL exactly where the published text is 'Data removed' (1,712 rows).

expected.name: building_emissions_num
expected.description: The Building Emission Rate (kg of CO2 per square metre per year) as decimal(19,4). The same quantity as the domestic emissions per floor area.

expected.name: primary_energy_value_int
expected.description: The primary energy indicator (kWh per square metre per year) as an integer. The same quantity as the domestic primary energy indicator.
